requests.prompt:
Redraw the character from the reference image as a super-deformed (SD) chibi mascot bust sticker for a desktop pet widget. Style: cute Japanese mascot, 2.5-head-tall proportions, very large head, upper body only cropped at the chest, head slightly tilted, body and face turned slightly to the LEFT with generous empty white space in the upper-left of the frame.

Keep the character identity exactly: long white twin-tails with orange gradient streaks, oversized black wide-brim witch hat with an orange crown and white bunny ears on top, orange eyes, small X-shaped orange hair clip, one ahoge hair strand sticking up.

Simplify the costume for small-size readability: white frilled collar with a small orange ribbon, orange-and-black capelet over the shoulders, plain white ruffled blouse. Remove fine lace, ribbons, legwear, thigh-high socks, boots and the bunny plush.

Rendering: bold dark brown outline, flat cel shading with a single soft gradient highlight in the hair, restricted palette of orange, white and black only, clean readable silhouette.

Plain solid WHITE background, sticker cut-out, no shadow on the background, no text, no watermark, no frame.
